outcomes.name: The approach to change adoption has been refined based on pilot learnings
The approach to change adoption is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Planning & Risk to identify what needs to change in the approach to change adoption before scaling.
Refine the approach to change adoption to Planning & Risk based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined approach to change adoption covering Planning & Risk ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined approach to change adoption for Planning & Risk is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the approach to change adoption for Planning & Risk remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the approach to change adoption affected Skills & Behaviour.
Adapt the approach to change adoption relating to Skills & Behaviour for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the approach to change adoption covering Skills & Behaviour to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the approach to change adoption for Skills & Behaviour.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the approach to change adoption affected Process & Sustainment.
Adapt the approach to change adoption relating to Process & Sustainment for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the approach to change adoption covering Process & Sustainment to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Process & Sustainment among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the approach to change adoption for Process & Sustainment.
